message_en: Capitulation-zone reading — historically two-sided. Growth scare 90 (extreme) alongside a depth extreme: IWM washout-turn (IHM). A washout can precede a bounce about as often as a further leg down.
message_zh: 资本投降区读数——历史上双向。成长恐慌 90（极端），同时出现深度极值：IWM 动量拐点洗盘（IHM）。洗盘之后反弹与再下跌概率相当。
disclaimer: Display-tier only. All may_* authority flags are False. It sits BESIDE the risk banner as context and never suppresses it. Forward ledger pre-registered as EXPECTED NULL — a capitulation-zone reading is historically TWO-SIDED (it precedes a bounce about as often as a further leg down); it is context, not a forecast, not a buy signal. Price depth = trailing-63-session drawdown percentile vs 10y self-history; momentum depth (if shown) = IHM MACD-histogram depth, a different quantity, labeled separately. The word 'validated' does not appear on these surfaces.
